input.prompt:
A real night photograph of giant digital billboards in a dense city entertainment square: From inside a dark, empty elevated train car, a giant landscape screen on the building across the street fills the train window.

The output is one single photograph, portrait 4:5.

Composition A, centred and symmetric: the design surface sits on the centre line, square to the camera, with even space on both sides; strong verticals and horizontals run parallel to the frame. Shot: Camera inside at the window, 35mm lens, f/4, square to the glass and the far screen. The screen fills about 55 percent of the frame width through the window, sharp; the dark window frame and a steel grab pole edge the photo; faint reflections on the glass, never over the screen. Nobody is in frame.

Place: A dense city entertainment square at night: tall towers stacked with giant LED screens, wet asphalt and pavements. Every screen in the square is a clean geometric shape with crisp edges and every screen shows a plain white full-screen image, ready for a design; no colour, text, logos or pictures on any screen.

Light: Night lit by the giant white screens: cool clean light spills across the wet streets and facades; small warm accents from traffic lights, street lamps and marquee bulbs; clean air, no smoke.

Palette and grade: Deep near-black night, glowing pure white screens, wet asphalt reflections, a few small red, amber and yellow accents from traffic and street lights. The same grade on every image of the collection.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph of a giant digital billboard, so the design surface is the hero: it is large in the frame and the camera is close enough that it dominates. It is a real place on a real wet night, shot from a real vantage point. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are in frame. The hero screen is crisp at its edges and corners, with no bloom around it. Every screen is big and generous, a full billboard, never a thin strip or a small sliver. Each screen is one simple plain rectangle, a single clean panel, never complex, curved, split or oddly shaped. Traffic moves naturally at uneven spacing, never lined up in neat rows.

Design surface: EVERY SCREEN IN THE FRAME SHOWS A PLAIN WHITE FULL-SCREEN IMAGE, glowing bright and clean, evenly lit edge to edge yet not blown out, each a crisp geometric shape with sharp corners; nothing crosses them.

Finish: Shot on a full-frame camera at night like real street photography: fine natural grain, true deep blacks, crisp highlights without bloom; real, never a render, never cyberpunk.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, any image or text on the design surface, tiny people in the street, halation, bloom or glow around the screen, smoke or haze, a sci-fi or 3D render look.
